def transform(g):
    g=[list(r) for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    line=next(i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(v==2 for v in r))
    res=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    res[line]=[2]*w
    fours=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==4]
    fours.sort(key=lambda p: abs(p[0]-line))
    drawn=set()
    for (r,c) in fours:
        d=1 if r<line else -1
        apex=(r+d,c)
        res[apex[0]][apex[1]]=4
        own={apex}; drawn.add(apex)
        for dj in (-1,1):
            k=1
            while True:
                i2,j2=apex[0]-d*k, c+dj*k
                if not(0<=i2<h and 0<=j2<w): break
                if (i2,j2) in drawn: break
                if any(max(abs(i2-a),abs(j2-b))==1 for (a,b) in drawn-own): break
                res[i2][j2]=4; own.add((i2,j2)); drawn.add((i2,j2)); k+=1
    return res
